:::{#sol-scalar-practice}

The tallest student's height and the number of students are [scalars](#def-scalar):
each is one [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).
The list of heights holds $30$ numbers,
so it is a [column vector](#def-column-vector) in $\reals^{30}$,
not a scalar.

:::
